description.value: Comma Cafe is a UBC Okanagan Food Services outlet tucked inside The Commons building on the UBCO campus, serving Doi Chaang specialty coffee alongside hand-crafted sandwiches, seasonal salads made with locally sourced ingredients, and house-made pastries. It operates as a self-funded ancillary of the university, with profits supporting student programs and the academic mission. A touring cyclist passing through the UBC Okanagan campus will find a relaxed spot to refuel with fresh, scratch-made food in a campus commons environment.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Comma Cafe is a UBC Okanagan Food Services outlet in The Commons building at 3297 University Way, Kelowna, serving Doi Chaang coffee, hand-crafted sandwiches, salads with locally sourced ingredients, and house-made pastries. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, or Wi-Fi amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those remain null. OSM closing time (18:00) conflicts with the website (4 PM), and OSM omits Tuesday from operating days while the website lists Mon–Fri.
concerns: OSM opening_hours lists closing time as 18:00 but website states 4 PM (16:00); OSM also omits Tuesday while website lists Monday–Friday.
OSM record has no address; website address (3297 University Way, Kelowna, BC) used instead.
No phone number in OSM; general UBCO Food Services number (250-807-9208) from website is not specific to Comma Cafe.
Campus café — physical access for non-UBC visitors during non-peak periods is unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Comma is a legitimate café serving fresh food on the publicly accessible UBCO campus, so touring cyclists could stop here; however, none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from available evidence, and the campus location may limit after-hours access for cyclists. A site visit or direct contact is needed to verify minimum criteria before including.
